entities.name: Ernő Goldfinger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ernő Goldfinger was a Hungarian-born British architect and furniture designer. He moved to the United Kingdom in the 1930s, and became a key member of the Modernist architectural movement. He is most prominently remembered for designing residential tower blocks, some of which are now listed buildings.
